o.text: From Proto-Turkic *yïk- (“to crush, grind; overthrow”). Cognate with Turkish yıkmak.

glosses: crossbar (a transverse bar or piece, such as a bar across a door)

o.text: From Proto-Turkic *at, whence also Azerbaijani atım (“pinch”). Cognate with dialectal Turkish atkı (“large pitchfork”), dialectal Tatar аткыры (atqırı, “crosswise”).
From at (“to throw”) + -qı. Cognate with Turkish atkı (“shawl”).
From Arabic مَا شَاءَ ٱللّٰهُ (mā šāʔa llāhu).
From Proto-Turkic *sogulčan. Compare Turkish solucan (“worm”), Turkmen soguljan, Gagauz solucan, Salar soğulcañ.
